title: HELIX Terminology: Identifier Type
description: Types of identifiers that can be assigned to a person or entity across systems.

codes.definition: The primary student/person ID assigned by the institution
Government-issued national identifier (e.g., SSN in US, SIN in Canada, NI Number in UK)
Last 4 digits of Social Security Number. Full SSN should never be stored in HELIX.
When used as an identifier (e.g., for SSO matching)
System-generated internal key (e.g., Banner PIDM, PeopleSoft EmplID). Not typically exposed to end users.
ID from a previous institution (useful for transfer matching)
National Student Clearinghouse or equivalent ID
Open Researcher and Contributor ID for research/publishing
